description: Implementation of the QuicheDataReader class for reading various data types from a byte buffer, including support for variable-length integers and byte order conversions.

classes.name: QuicheDataReader
classes.description: A class for reading various data types from a byte buffer with support for different byte orders and variable-length integers.

methods.name: ReadUInt8
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit unsigned integer from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadUInt16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit unsigned integer, converting from network byte order if necessary.

methods.name: ReadUInt24
methods.description: Reads a 24-bit unsigned integer in network byte order.

methods.name: ReadUInt32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit unsigned integer, converting from network byte order if necessary.

methods.name: ReadUInt64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit unsigned integer, converting from network byte order if necessary.

methods.name: ReadBytesToUInt64
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes into a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: ReadStringPiece16
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed string of 16-bit length.

methods.name: ReadStringPiece8
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed string of 8-bit length.

methods.name: ReadStringPiece
methods.description: Reads a string of specified size.

methods.name: ReadTag
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit tag.

methods.name: ReadDecimal64
methods.description: Reads a decimal number with specified digits.

methods.name: PeekVarInt62Length
methods.description: Peeks the length of a 62-bit variable-length integer.

methods.name: ReadVarInt62
methods.description: Reads a 62-bit variable-length integer.

methods.name: ReadStringPieceVarInt62
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed string where length is a 62-bit variable-length integer.

methods.name: ReadRemainingPayload
methods.description: Returns the remaining payload as a string view and advances the position to the end.

methods.name: PeekRemainingPayload
methods.description: Returns the remaining payload without advancing the position.

methods.name: FullPayload
methods.description: Returns the entire data buffer as a string view.

methods.name: PreviouslyReadPayload
methods.description: Returns the data buffer up to the current position.

methods.name: ReadBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes into a buffer.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Advances the read position by a specified size.

methods.name: IsDoneReading
methods.description: Checks if all data has been read.

methods.name: BytesRemaining
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes remaining to be read.

methods.name: TruncateRemaining
methods.description: Truncates the remaining data to a specified length.

methods.name: CanRead
methods.description: Checks if a specified number of bytes can be read.

methods.name: OnFailure
methods.description: Handles read failure by setting position to the end.

methods.name: PeekByte
methods.description: Returns the next byte without advancing the position.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string with debug information about the current state.
